Plot GnRH coexpression markers

Source: R/visualization.R
plot_gnrh_coexpr.Rd

Visualizes genes coexpressed with GNRH1 and ranks them by coexpression strength.

Usage

plot_gnrh_coexpr(df, coexp_cutoff = 0.25, txtsize = 10)

Arguments

df

A marker table returned by gnrh_markers. Must contain the columns gene, coexpr, score, and p_val_adj.

coexp_cutoff

Minimum coexpression value required for plotting. Default is 0.25.

txtsize

Base text size passed to plot_theme. Default is 12.

Value

A ggplot2 object showing coexpression strength, marker score, and adjusted p-value significance.

Details

GNRH1 itself is removed before plotting. Genes are ordered by decreasing coexpression strength.

Point aesthetics:

  • x-axis: correlation with GNRH1

  • y-axis: coexpressed genes

  • point size: composite marker score

  • point color: \(-log10(adjusted~p-value)\)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
p <- plot_gnrh_coexpr(
  markers,
  coexp_cutoff = 0.35
)

print(p)
} # }
